subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel preference and required invoice fields
body:
--- Message 1 (oldest) ---
From: Monica Ruiz <accounts@silverpeak.com>
To: Redwood Inference Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup question — how should we submit invoices?

Hi team,

We (SilverPeak Logistics) are finalizing our vendor setup and had a quick question on the invoice submission path. Our AP team currently sends invoices as PDFs via email into our ERP, but for new vendors you mentioned there is a portal option. Before we go live I wanted to confirm a few things:

- Do you prefer portal ingestion or are emailed PDFs acceptable as a default?
- If portal: do you require CSV header fields vs. embedded PO numbers in PDF?
- PO stamping: does Redwood require the PO # at the top-level invoice header or as line-item metadata?
- Any special subject-line tokens or acknowledgement headers we need to include for automated routing?

We can fill the vendor onboarding form if that helps — attaching the quick contact sheet.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Ruiz
Accounts Payable Manager
SilverPeak Logistics
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

--- Message 2 ---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Monica Ruiz <accounts@silverpeak.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup question — how should we submit invoices?

Hi Monica —

Great to hear from you and welcome aboard. Short answer: portal first, email fallback. That said, many customers start with email for the first few invoices while they complete ERP mappings. Below is a concise set of guidance so your AP team can choose the best path: 

Portal (recommended for volume/automation):
- Upload a CSV (preferred) or structured JSONL for bulk runs.
- Required CSV headers we use for automated PO match: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount (decimal), currency, po_number, vendor_name, line_count.
- Line items may be provided in a related CSV file or as repeated lines; if you send a separate line file include invoice_number to join.
- Portal provides immediate acknowledgement and an idempotency token for retries.

Email (fallback/go-live):
- Send PDF invoices to invoices@redwood.com with subject: "Invoice: <your_company> <invoice_number>" (include exact PO(s) in the body and on the first page of the PDF).
- Include a one-line machine-readable header in the email body: PO:<po_number> | INV:<invoice_number> | ENTITY:<entity_code>
- We support subject-token routing but email subject must contain at least the invoice number for automated ingestion.

PO stamping guidance:
- Preferred: PO number in the invoice header (top of PDF) and in the CSV po_number column. That yields the highest automated match rate.
- Acceptable: PO per line item, but when PO is per line we ask you to still include a top-level summary row with the PO(s) and totals to speed reconciliation.

Attachments and sample: I've attached a short sample CSV with header row (sample_invoice_csv.csv) and linked our onboarding form. Please review and let us know which path you prefer.

Next steps:
1) If portal: I can provision access for your AP contact and share the upload endpoint and sample file layout.
2) If email: we'll provide the precise subject-line token and a test address for go-live verification.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Ruiz <accounts@silverpeak.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup question — how should we submit invoices?

Thanks Steph. Monica — couple of quick clarifications from the PO-match side:

- VAT/GST handling: If you need tax-exempt handling (multiple tax rows), include a tax_total column and a per-line tax_rate column.
- Multi-PO invoices: we accept multiple PO numbers in the po_number column separated by semicolons; make sure to list the PO(s) in the email body as well for email ingestion.
- For go-live week we often enable an "email pilot" where PDFs are accepted but also uploaded to the portal by CS to seed the ledger. Let us know if you'd like that.

One operational ask: if you send email PDFs, please avoid forwarding chains. Send the original PDF as a single attachment so our OCR/ingest pipeline sees a clean file.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Billing Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Monica Ruiz <accounts@silverpeak.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 11:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup question — how should we submit invoices?

Thanks Stephanie and Jordan — this is helpful. A couple of notes from our side:

- Our ERP (FreightCore v8) currently prefers PDFs and expects invoice-level header fields. Extracting line-level data is an extra step for us.
- We can export a simple CSV for bulk shipments, but will need a mapping document from Redwood to ensure the header names line up.
- For the immediate go-live we'd like to start with email (PDF) submission for the first 2 weeks while we test the CSV export into our SFTP. After that we can switch to portal.

Would you be able to provision a short test address and confirm the exact subject token and minimal email body header that will guarantee automatic routing? Also, can you confirm whether PO numbers stamped on line items only will still allow us to pass the invoice during the pilot?

Thanks,
Monica

--- Message 5 (latest) ---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Monica Ruiz <accounts@silverpeak.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Dec 2027 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup question — how should we submit invoices?

Hi Monica — happy to coordinate the pilot. Summary / proposal: 

1) Hybrid go-live plan (agreed):
   - Week 0–2: Email PDF ingestion to invoices+silverpeak@invoices.redwood.com (pilot address). Please send original PDFs only and include a one-line header in the email body: PO:<po_number> | INV:<invoice_number> | ENTITY:SPK-01
   - After week 2: portal onboarding. We'll provide SFTP + portal credentials and a sample CSV mapping.

2) PO-line-only invoices:
   - We will accept PO on line items during the pilot, but please include a top-level summary row in the PDF (or the email body) that lists the PO(s) and invoice total. That avoids manual intervention.

3) Sample files & provisioning:
   - Attached: sample_invoice_csv.csv (header row in first sheet).
   - I'll ask Ops to send the onboarding portal invite once you confirm the pilot start date.

4) Acceptance SLA and acknowledgements:
   - Pilot emails get automated ack within 2 hours during business hours; portal uploads ack in <1 minute.

Next steps for you: confirm pilot start date and attach one example PDF invoice for us to validate mapping.

Thanks — looping in Jordan for any integration follow-ups.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_invoice_csv.csv

--- End of thread ---
